accessibility.evidence: Updated ui-smoke.json records zero automated WCAG A/AA violations across home, empty collection, reply, reveal, hello, shared/hidden cards, collection and sample reveal. accessibility.json checks the writing form and help dialog at both primary viewports. Keyboard focus containment/restoration and reduced motion pass; shore-interactions.json checks keyboard Enter, pointer shaking and synthetic mobile permission denial/grant. No physical-phone or assistive-technology user study. Updated motion checks compare actual sea pixels before/after pause, verify reduced-motion stillness and a synthetic hidden-tab event, and exercise the no-WebGL CSS fallback. The paper opens as one connected mesh; keyboard focus transfers from Open bottle to the readable heading. catch-first.json checks the new optional contribution flow at 360 and 1440 pixels with zero automated WCAG violations.

See shore-interactions.json and phone-motion-denied.png. Physical sensor behavior remains untested.
